Change email, role or status (owner/admin; only an owner can touch an owner)

post.description: An admin may invite admin or agent; only an owner may invite an owner. The caller must have a verified email (403 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED). Re-inviting the same address replaces the pending invite.
post.summary: Invite a staff member by email (owner/admin)

delete.summary: Revoke a pending invite (owner/admin; only an owner for an owner invite)

post.description: Public. The token comes from the emailed link, is single use and valid for seven days. The new user is created with the invited role and a verified email.
post.summary: Accept an invitation: choose a password and sign in

get.description: No authentication. Only public, active plans (Free, Pro, Enterprise today): the hidden Starter plan is never listed. Amounts are integer minor units of `currency`; `priceMinor: null` means "custom quote".
Agents cannot read billing (403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE). `skip` / `take` page the invoice list, newest first. Usage against the limits is not reported yet (the counters arrive with the gateway, Phase 3).
get.summary: Current plan, status, period, limits and invoices (owner/admin)

get.description: `skip` / `take` apply to both lists, newest first.
get.summary: A tenant's subscription, invoices and billing event log

post.description: Moves Starter/Free (or another plan) to `planCode`, starting now, until `periodEnd` or one `interval`. Use `record-payment` for a renewal of the current plan.
post.summary: Activate a paid plan after a payment (creates a paid invoice)

post.description: The new period starts when the current one ends (or now when it already ended) and lasts one `interval` or until `periodEnd`. A renewal also clears a pending cancellation and a past-due state.
post.summary: Record a renewal payment of the current paid plan (creates a paid invoice)
Extend the current period (for example Starter), no invoice
Change the plan without a payment (upgrade, downgrade, comp), no invoice

post.description: By default the plan is kept until the period ends (`status: canceled`) and then falls back to Free; `atPeriodEnd: false` falls back now.

get.description: Default OFF. This only records the owner's choice; no training export exists (it needs legal review first).
get.summary: Consent to use conversations for model training (owner only)

put.description: `enabled: true` needs `termsVersion`. Recorded with who accepted and when; revoking keeps the history and is audited. Admins and agents get 403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE.

get.summary: Who am I: profile, role, tenant (slug, plan, status) and language

patch.summary: Change my own name or dashboard language

get.description: A flat map of stable dot-notation keys to ICU message strings. Keys missing in the requested language are filled in from `en`. Supports `If-None-Match` (304). For API errors use namespace `errors` with the error `code` as key.
